I pulled this from the Algolia Hacker News API (`hn.algolia.com/api/v1/search?tags=front_page`), which is HN's public search API, so nothing was scraped. These are the top 5 front-page stories right now:

| # | Title | Points | URL |
|---|-------|--------|-----|
| 1 | Tesla Roadster | 1179 | https://www.tesla.com/roadster |
| 2 | Claude reveals ECDSA curve origins | 662 | https://www.anthropic.com/research/ecdsa-curve-origins |
| 3 | 90% of US working hours are spent on tasks not covered well by AI benchmarks | 393 | https://www.mercor.com/research/labor-index/benchmark-map/ |
| 4 | I Love Software Rendering | 284 | https://www.jamesfmackenzie.com/2026/10/13/i-love-software-rendering/ |
| 5 | Waymo in Toronto | 265 | https://waymo.com/blog/2026/10/waymo-in-toronto/ |

Here is the same data as JSON:

```json
[
  {"title": "Tesla Roadster", "points": 1179, "url": "https://www.tesla.com/roadster"},
  {"title": "Claude reveals ECDSA curve origins", "points": 662, "url": "https://www.anthropic.com/research/ecdsa-curve-origins"},
  {"title": "90% of US working hours are spent on tasks not covered well by AI benchmarks", "points": 393, "url": "https://www.mercor.com/research/labor-index/benchmark-map/"},
  {"title": "I Love Software Rendering", "points": 284, "url": "https://www.jamesfmackenzie.com/2026/10/13/i-love-software-rendering/"},
  {"title": "Waymo in Toronto", "points": 265, "url": "https://waymo.com/blog/2026/10/waymo-in-toronto/"}
]
```

I fell back to the HN discussion link (`https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=<id>`) for any story with no external URL, but all five here have one. The Algolia front-page ranking can differ slightly from the live HN homepage order.
